title: Winter Burrow
tagline: A little mouse rebuilds a burrow through a long winter — follow the owl, find Aunty, and furnish the house.
order_note: In walkthrough order, following the story pages: the beginning, following the owl, Aunty's recovery, rebuilding the burrow, then the furnishing cleanup. Cumulative achievements (wood, kills, cooking, furniture) pop whenever their totals land, so they may arrive earlier or later than listed.
scope_note: Full game: all 32 achievements / 1,000G. No missables; about 8–10 hours in a single playthrough.

achievements.name: Protector of Dreams
achievements.req: Place a bed in the burrow
achievements.how: Craft a Simple Bed at the woodworking table (4 twigs, 3 flax fiber, 2 beech wood) and place it in your home.

achievements.name: Knitting Advocate
achievements.how: Repair the Dusty Armchair (2 beech planks, 4 twigs, 10 flax fiber) — this also unlocks the knitting recipes.

achievements.name: Keen on Cooking
achievements.req: Repair the stove in the burrow
achievements.how: Repair the stove with 8 pebbles gathered outside the house.

achievements.name: Bridge of Reunion
achievements.how: Repair the broken bridge south-east of your house (5 beech planks, 5 flax rope), then cross to Aunty.

achievements.name: Basement Dweller
achievements.req: Unlock the door to the basement
achievements.how: Use the Basement Key from Aunty on the basement door to the left of the house.

achievements.name: Gnarled Discoveries
achievements.how: Cross the bridge past Aunty's collapsed home into the new area to discover the Gnarled Oaks.

achievements.name: Gloomy Adventures
achievements.how: Head north past Bufo into the next area to discover the Shadow Pines.

achievements.name: Mouse of the Wild
achievements.req: Build a campfire in the wilderness
achievements.how: Use a campfire kit from a backpack north-east of Gnawtusk's area to build a campfire in the wilderness.

achievements.name: Aunty's Saviour
achievements.how: Finish Gnawtusk's herb stashes (by the pine tree, by the shell, by the funny-looking rock), then talk to Aunty back home.

achievements.name: A Full Basket
achievements.how: Collect 100 pieces of wood — it comes naturally while gathering for the planter boxes and repairs.

achievements.name: Reach for the Stars!
achievements.req: Unlock first floor in the burrow
achievements.how: Repair the stairs to the first floor (15 oak planks, 5 pine planks).

achievements.name: Hot Knitting Needles
achievements.how: Knit 8 clothing pieces — start with the linen set, then wool clothes from fur tufts once you have enough yarn.

achievements.name: Family Reunion
achievements.how: Finish Bufo's quests: fetch pebbles and twigs, find Pollywog south of the water, bake Blackberry and Rowanberry pies, and deliver Bufo's key to Pollywog.

achievements.name: Frozen Horizons
achievements.how: Head south-west past the spider area to discover the White Pillars, collecting birch wood there.

achievements.name: Pickaxe Champion
achievements.how: Craft all pickaxes, ending with the Flint Pickaxe once Willow's area gives you birch wood.

achievements.name: Axe Master
achievements.how: Craft all axes, ending with the Flint Axe.

achievements.name: Willow's Epiphany
achievements.how: Finish Willow's quests: return their notebook (found outside your house), find the tunnel entrance north-east of home with the Flint Shovel, recover the helmet artifact, and hand over hazelnuts.

achievements.name: Pest Control
achievements.how: Kill 100 creatures — beetles, ants, and spiders as you travel; it usually pops while gathering for Aunty's burrow.

achievements.name: Let's Start Over
achievements.how: Rebuild Aunty's burrow: 10 birch planks, 20 oak planks, 20 granite, 10 silk yarn (spiders drop silk — cut their webs if you'd rather not fight them).

achievements.name: Friends in a Nutshell
achievements.how: Finish Gnawtusk's quests by handing over the rare herbs you picked up in backpacks, then invite him to the feast.

achievements.name: Yearning for Yarn
achievements.how: Spin 50 balls of yarn at the armchair — it builds up naturally while knitting clothes and the Warm Shoes.

achievements.name: Moss Moves On
achievements.how: Finish Moss's quests: bring the white fox fur tufts, find his missing key, show him Aunty's Old Shawl, then bring back Pinesap's pendant from the dark area west of the hood.

achievements.name: A Well-Earned Feast
achievements.req: Have a big dinner at Aunty's
achievements.how: Invite everyone — Gnawtusk, Bufo, Willow, and Moss — then return to Aunty to trigger the feast and the story ending.

achievements.name: Culinary Completionist
achievements.how: Cook 100 recipes — Roasted Chanterelle and Blue Tea are the cheapest to spam, and 'Craft All' speeds it up.

achievements.name: Twig House
achievements.req: Craft 8 pieces of the twig furniture set
achievements.how: Craft 8 twig furniture pieces — Twig Side Tables use the least materials.

achievements.name: Fibre House
achievements.req: Craft 9 pieces of the fibre furniture set
achievements.how: Craft 9 fibre pieces — Round Fibre Rugs are the cheapest, though they eat a lot of flax rope.

achievements.name: Master Builder
achievements.how: Craft 150 woodworking recipes — it usually pops while working through the furniture sets.

achievements.name: Pine House
achievements.req: Craft 9 pieces of the pine furniture set
achievements.how: Craft 9 pine pieces — Pine Chairs are the simplest.

achievements.name: Birch House
achievements.req: Craft 9 pieces of the birch furniture set
achievements.how: Craft 9 birch pieces — Birch Stools are the easiest.

achievements.name: Full House
achievements.how: Craft 30 furniture pieces in total — it pops while working through the sets.

achievements.name: Pebble House
achievements.req: Craft 9 pieces of the pebble furniture set
achievements.how: Craft 9 pebble pieces — Pebble Stools are the easiest.

achievements.name: Oak House
achievements.req: Craft 9 pieces of the oak furniture set
achievements.how: Craft 9 oak pieces — Oak Tables are the easiest.
